Grasp vs Hevy

Prices and features checked 27 October 2026 on each app's own pages and store listings. They can change.

In short

A great free logger with a big community. Planning for you, and raising your weights, is in Hevy Trainer, which needs Pro. Grasp does both for free.

At a glance

Feature Grasp Hevy
Price✓ Free$2.99/mo · $23.99/yr · $74.99 lifetime

How each plans your training

Grasp: Grasp builds each session from your goal, days, time and equipment, then raises a weight when you reach the top of the rep range on every set, and lowers it if you miss twice. Simple rules on your phone, free.

Hevy: Hevy Trainer builds a program from your goal, equipment and days, and raises a weight once you hit the top of the rep range on every set: the same rule Grasp uses. It is part of Hevy Pro.

Choose Grasp if

  • You want your sessions planned for you, for free
  • You want your next weights worked out from what you lifted
  • You train in Arabic, or with no internet

Choose Hevy if

  • You want a social feed and to follow friends
  • You train with an Apple Watch or Wear OS watch
  • You want to log from a web browser too
